title: Is GTA 6 Spying on You? The Viral Insurer Claim, Fact-Checked

segments.text: Is GTA Six secretly profiling you, and selling it to insurers?
Welcome to Paravion X. Daily world news, and whether it's real or fake.
A viral post claims a fired Rockstar engineer found a hidden system called Lens.
It supposedly scores your impulse control and aggression from how you play.
Then a secret Take-Two company sells those profiles to insurers.
Check one. That company, Vantage Analytics, isn't in any of Take-Two's SEC filings.
Check two. The account is anonymous, created in August, and its firing email shows signs of a fake.

segments.claim: GTA VI sells your psych profile to insurers
segments.why: NO EVIDENCE · FRANCE 24, WHAT THE FACT
segments.text: The verdict? Fake. There's no evidence.
But here's the twist. Take-Two's real privacy policy does build profile inferences, and shares them with advertisers.

segments.sub: OPT-OUT · 'DO NOT SELL OR SHARE' · TAKE-TWO
segments.text: Not insurers. Advertisers. And in many places, you can opt out.
